purpose: Commissioned CHP ramp/start/stop/dwell identifiability and model holdout validation; 15-minute energy readings are insufficient
sample_rate_qualification: Engineering starting point only. Confirm sensor/controller bandwidth, anti-alias filters, scan cycle, NTP/PTP clock sync and actual start dynamics before specifying final rate.

mandatory_columns.name: timestamp_utc
mandatory_columns.scope: common time base with documented maximum offset

mandatory_columns.name: generator_terminal_power_kw_e
mandatory_columns.scope: independent calibrated actual output, not controller demand

mandatory_columns.name: engine_gas_flow_nm3_dry_per_hour
mandatory_columns.scope: metered actual inlet flow and lag

mandatory_columns.name: fuel_lhv_mj_per_nm3_dry
mandatory_columns.scope: time-matched analyzer/sample with gas transport delay

mandatory_columns.name: useful_heat_power_kw_th
mandatory_columns.scope: heat meter at useful heat delivery boundary

mandatory_columns.name: data_quality_flag
mandatory_columns.scope: do not silently fill or interpolate missing records

required_companion_artifacts: engine nameplate, model variant, serial, gas approval and emission settings
instrument IDs, calibration certificates, validity, correction and covariance notes
clock alignment tests and acquisition software versions
load-step, startup, stop and trip logs (test only with site safety approval)
maintenance, derating, ambient, fuel-gas and operator interventions
retained immutable raw files, SHA256 and access authorization
